note: 36 cases: 15 matched pairs plus 6 covered cases. Each pair shares a company, a policy with a discretion clause, and the same small miss past the policy line; one version has a sound reason and the other a weak one. The 6 covered cases are clearly inside the policy.

cases.title: Water damage claim
cases.request: payment of a $4,200 claim for water damage to a kitchen floor, reported 16 days after discovery
cases.policy: Losses must be reported within 14 days of discovery. Late reports may be denied. Adjusters may accept late reports for good cause.
cases.record: A supply line under the sink burst while the customer was abroad. The plumber's report is dated the day the customer returned, and the adjuster's photos are consistent with a single sudden release of water. The customer reported the loss two days after the window closed, on the first business day after returning.

cases.title: Overdraft fee
cases.request: a waiver of a $35 overdraft fee
cases.policy: Customers may receive one courtesy overdraft-fee waiver in any rolling 12 months. Agents may grant additional waivers at their discretion.
cases.record: The customer received a courtesy waiver eleven months ago. This overdraft was caused by a merchant charging a $212 purchase twice; the duplicate posted first, the account went negative, and the merchant reversed it two days later. Without the duplicate the account would have stayed positive.

cases.title: Fuel charge

cases.record: The receipt is from a station two miles from the branch, timestamped twenty minutes before the recorded return, for a volume consistent with a full tank. The customer's dashboard photo shows the gauge at full. The return inspection recorded the gauge at seven-eighths.

cases.title: Billing correction
cases.request: an immediate refund of $115 for a billing correction identified 95 days after the bill
cases.policy: Billing corrections identified within 90 days of the bill are refunded. Older corrections are applied as a credit to the next bill. Agents may refund older corrections at their discretion.
cases.record: The bill was based on the company's estimated reading. The customer submitted actual readings on time each month; the estimate was used in error, and the correction to $95 from $210 came from the company's own audit at day 95.

cases.title: Billing correction
cases.request: an immediate refund of $115 for a billing correction identified 95 days after the bill
cases.policy: Billing corrections identified within 90 days of the bill are refunded. Older corrections are applied as a credit to the next bill. Agents may refund older corrections at their discretion.
cases.record: The bill was based on an estimated reading because the customer missed two monthly reading submissions. When the customer submitted a reading at day 95 the bill was corrected to $95 from $210. Estimation after missed submissions follows the published policy.

cases.title: Damaged dresser
cases.request: $400 for a dresser damaged in a move, claimed without a damage notation on the delivery form
cases.policy: Damage claims require a notation on the delivery form at the time of delivery. Claims without a notation may be accepted at the agent's discretion.
cases.record: The delivery form was signed without a damage notation. The customer's photos, timestamped the evening of delivery, show a split panel on the back of the dresser, which faced the wall when placed. The crew's own loading photo from the morning shows the panel intact.
